## ✅ Executive Summary
This readout covers 3 functional requirements for Multi-Currency Pricing Engine, assessed at Medium overall impact. The dependency graph carries an unresolved cycle flagged upstream: Build Currency Service FX Refresh → Build Pricing Engine Conversion Logic → Shared FX Config Module → back to Build Currency Service FX Refresh. Sequencing below should be treated as incomplete until that cycle is resolved. The biggest risk, consistent with this flag, is that the FX rate refresh and the Pricing Engine's conversion logic share a single configuration module, coupling the two services and complicating independent deployment. One open question remains, on whether the base-currency fallback notice must stay visible through checkout completion or may be dismissed.

## Requirements

### FR-001: Price Display in Customer's Local Currency
**Statement:** As a shopper browsing from outside the base-currency market, I want to see product prices in my local currency, so that I understand what I'll actually be charged.

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
| Category | Boundary Condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Performance | Currency-converted price must render within 300ms of page load | Stakeholder interview, Storefront team |

### FR-002: Real-Time FX Rate Refresh
**Statement:** As a pricing operations analyst, I want displayed FX rates refreshed on a fixed schedule, so that displayed prices don't drift too far from live market rates.

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
| Category | Boundary Condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Data Freshness | FX rates must refresh at least every 15 minutes during market hours | Finance team standard |

### FR-003: Fallback to Base Currency on FX Provider Outage
**Statement:** As a system, when the FX rate provider is unreachable, I must fall back to displaying base-currency pricing with a clear notice, so that checkout is never blocked by a third-party outage.

**Non-Functional Requirements:**
| Category | Boundary Condition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Availability | Fallback must engage within 5 seconds of provider timeout and must not block checkout | SRE standard |

## Impact: What This Touches

**Existing-System Impact**

| Existing System (CI) | Touched? | How / Why Not | Component(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pricing Engine | Yes | Adds currency-conversion logic to existing price calculation | FR-001, FR-003 |
| Currency Service | Yes | New FX rate refresh scheduling and shared config module changes | FR-002 |
| Storefront Web | Yes | Renders converted price and the fallback notice | FR-001, FR-003 |
| Order Management | No | Orders are still recorded in base currency; conversion is display-only | — |

**Components Identified**

| Requirement | Component (new/existing) | Blast Radius | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Currency Conversion Adapter (new) | Medium | New display-layer component reading from Pricing Engine and Currency Service |
| FR-002 | FX Rate Refresh Scheduler (new) | Medium | New scheduled job in Currency Service |
| FR-003 | Fallback Notice Component (new) | Low | Frontend-only notice banner |

**Blast Radius Rollup:** 0 High / 2 Medium / 1 Low — no single-component concentration; the two Medium items sit in different services (Pricing Engine's adapter vs. Currency Service's scheduler).

## Assumptions, Constraints, Risks & Open Questions

### Assumptions
- **Base-currency pricing remains the system of record** (underlies FR-001, FR-003): We assume the existing Pricing Engine's base-currency price remains authoritative; converted prices are a display-layer concern only, not a new pricing source of truth.

### Constraints
- **Single approved FX data provider** (constrains FR-002): Only the already-contracted FX provider may be used; no second provider may be integrated for this phase.

### Risks
- **Shared FX config module couples Currency Service and Pricing Engine** (affects FR-002, program-level): The FX rate refresh and the Pricing Engine's conversion logic currently share a single configuration module, creating a tight coupling that could complicate independent deployment of the two services.

### Open Questions
- FR-003 (Availability): TBD whether the base-currency fallback notice should be dismissible by the shopper or must remain visible through checkout completion.

## External Dependencies
- FX rate data is sourced from the existing, already-contracted FX provider; no new procurement needed.

## Flags & Data Quality
None — CMDB records for Pricing Engine and Currency Service were current as of assessment date.
